---

I want to calculate the total number of genes with regionally elevated expression in the forebrain (cerebral cortex, basal ganglia, thalamus and hypothalamus regions) in humans, pigs and mice.
```{r}
total_reg_human<-sum(180, 83, 57, 110)
print(total_reg_human)
total_reg_pig<-sum(109, 157, 31, 45)
print(total_reg_pig)
total_reg_mouse<-sum(55, 185, 60, 98)
print(total_reg_mouse)
```
Humans had the highest number of genes with regionally elevated expression.
